title: RevisionSnapshot
description: Stored entity state at one revision (spoke-history). The snapshot variant MUST agree with entity_kind: knowledge_entry -> KnowledgeEntry, relation -> Relation. Replay returns the stored entity as-is; derived state (e.g. modules.cognition) is entity data, not re-derived. Two providers returning the same snapshot at the same revision MUST produce identical bytes under RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

entity_kind.description: Open kind selector. Core vocabulary (documented, not enforced): knowledge_entry, relation. Products MAY add kinds; an unserved kind answers HISTORY_ENTITY_UNSUPPORTED after capability admission.

entity_id.description: Opaque stable entity id. Equals snapshot.entry_id for a knowledge entry and snapshot.relation_id for a relation.

revision.description: Revision represented by this snapshot; equals the selected entity snapshot's own revision.

snapshot.description: The stored entity as it stood at revision, using the existing data schemas without projecting away stored fields.

extensions.description: Product-namespace extensions. Unknown namespaces and keys round-trip unchanged.
